proposedContributions.change: Names are proposed, not existing APIs. Define shared request/result/runtime decoders without React/server imports. Request includes search, type/content format, owner/project/updated-range/shared filters, sort, source scope and opaque cursor; no trusted actor field. Result contains authorized canonical refs/origin/revision/descriptor metadata, supported total or explicit unsupported-count state, authorized unfiltered-source-empty classification, queryRevision/permissionEpoch/watermark/freshness and next cursor. Failure union preserves validation/conflict/denied/deleted/offlineUnsupported/missingDependency/rateLimited/unknownFormat. Compile LibraryFilter into the accepted LSX-WP-010 typed query shape; never compute ACL or totals by filtering already exposed title arrays. Query/cache identity binds actor transport, workspace/account, approved source binding, filter/sort/schema/policy revisions; stable ref tie-break comes from the snapshot owner. Export row-to-existing-alias/capability decisions using existing descriptor/identity helpers, not a second identity format.

Operations are normative proposed contracts, not current runtime symbols. Consume real authenticated library owner APIs and render RD-01 inside the existing destination: 200ms debounced search with explicit Enter and IME safety; filter chips and clear-all retaining query; same authorized IDs in list/grid; stable canonical selection independent of sorting; unsupported total uses shown-row count. Failed requests retain exact input/cursor; request generation suppresses late results across changed scope/query. Empty-source versus filtered-empty must be supplied from authorized source evidence, not inferred from an empty page. Render error/retry, denied, loading, authorized offline rows plus last-sync freshness; no offline create unless owner storage contract proves it. Request current descriptor/capabilities at open/create time, use existing owner route/alias and existing flush guard, and never create/adopt a descriptor merely to open. Capability menu includes Document/Note/Markdown map/Base/Sheet/Slides/Form/Folder; unsupported items remain explained and disabled with no route or artifact. Integrate Upload/Templates via existing owner if supported, otherwise expose honest capability status; do not implement a competing uploader/catalog. Subscribe to accepted owner watermarks/alias events, preserve selection by canonical identity and clear revoked metadata. Personal list/grid/filter preferences only, via existing owner contract.

Permanent behavioral assertions cover actor/source namespace isolation, ACL before filters/totals, supported versus unsupported totals, opaque cursor/query mismatch and policy invalidation, retained search/cursor on failure, empty-source versus filtered-empty versus unavailable/error, no duplicate/skipped ref across stable pages, watermark selection preservation, authoritative same-ref/revision/hash open with unchanged canonical entity count, and unsupported Sheet/Form create causing diagnostic but no artifact/route. Use isolated deterministic fixture/seed and real owner boundaries where necessary, not mocked forwarding echoes. Run the exact specified mutation creating a new Doc on existing-note selection and prove entity-count/ref/hash assertions fail; preserve baseline input and evaluated artifact hashes and all attempts.

Use the project-supported actual Electron runner after owner discovery, not a guessed command or fixture-only completion. Assert search/chip/clear/retry, list/grid identity, sorting announcement, row Enter, focus-owned Space, Cmd/Ctrl new-panel open, Shift-F10/menu/Escape focus return, unsupported menu interaction and absent artifact, revoke/denied cache clearing, offline freshness, loading/empty/error distinction and stable selection after reordered watermark. Collect pointer/keyboard/IME/focus/reduced-motion/200%-zoom/narrow/light-dark/Russian/all-locales evidence, screenshots/ARIA/computed font including Cyrillic. Bind proof to integrated revision and real native owner readback before/after restart.
